verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs describe exactly this: agent-specific pass-through payment tokens, purchase-intent mandates with declineThreshold amount/currency and effectiveUntilTime expiry, and credential retrieval requests scoped to a specific merchantName/merchant descriptor and amount — all gated behind passkey-authenticated user instructions. This directly matches 'scoped, limited-use credential with amount limits, expiry, merchant restrictions instead of raw card number.' missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Visa) hands-on confirmation that these scoped credentials work end-to-end in production rather than sandbox, since the product itself carries a documented maturity caveat.
